title: "Download handoffs" and "Download all" link to a downloads/ folder that ships nowhere, so the click replaces the whole tab with the browser's file-not-found page and the reader loses the app.
expected: Downloads are the stored bytes and the reader keeps their place (control-matrix.csv CT-048; apps/issuer-library/README.md, Evidence row: "the handoffs, each downloadable"; the library opens from disk).
actual: Fixture data supplies href="downloads/halden-aerostructures-2026-09-30-handoffs.zip" and "...-registers.zip" (web/fixtures/library.json:2766, :1941), plain same-tab links with no download attribute. web/dist has no downloads folder. Clicking either navigates the tab to chrome-error://chromewebdata/ (net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND); in the headless shell that is a blank white page, in a desktop browser an error page. The reader must press Back to return. The "Open" links beside it use target=_blank (not followed further). The shipped data.js carries no such link, so this shows only with populated data.
suggested_change: Ship the downloads folder beside index.html with any data file that links to it, or draw the link only when the file exists; open zip links with the download attribute so a missing file cannot replace the app.

screen: fixture build: Overview > "See the 7 gaps in Evidence", then Back and Forward (full)
title: The reader's scroll position leaks between pages: a link followed from a scrolled page opens the next page scrolled to the same offset (clamped to its height), and Back and Forward do not restore the place that was left.
expected: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md (J6 row: "Back and Forward"; J3 row: return "to where they were"); CT-047 expects focus to return to the opener, so the place is expected to survive a round trip.
actual: With the Overview scrolled to 700 (page height 3,144, window 900), following "See the 7 gaps in Evidence" opens Evidence > Gaps at scrollTop 314, the page's maximum: the issuer title, run chips and run tabs are above the window (title in window: false) and the reader lands part-way down. Back leaves the Overview at 314, not 700. Forward leaves Gaps at 314. The page scrolls inside <main>, which is neither reset on a route change nor stored per history entry.
suggested_change: On a route change reset <main> to the top; on Back and Forward restore the offset saved for that history entry.

screen: fixture build: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/overview, keyboard, Enter on the Changes tab (full)
title: Activating a run page's tab link with the keyboard drops focus to the document body, so the next Tab starts again at the top of the page instead of at the next tab.
expected: Focus stays on or near the control used, or moves to the new page's heading, and sequential navigation is not reset (WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order; PRODUCT.md, Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA is the working assumption).
actual: Tab order from load: Skip to content, five rail links, Library, the Show sources switch, Report history, New run, Overview, Changes. Enter on Changes loads the Changes page; document.activeElement is then BODY. The next Tab lands on the Library breadcrumb and it takes 7 Tab presses (Library, switch, Report history, New run, Overview, Changes, Modules) to reach the next tab, where 1 is expected. The tab strip is part of each page component, so it is unmounted and rebuilt on every tab change.
suggested_change: Keep the run frame and its tab strip mounted across the run's pages, or move focus to the new page's h1 (or the activated tab) after the route changes.

screen: fixture build: every Model page, e.g. #/model/transdigm/2025-06-30/front, then a trace control or "Back to the report" (full)
title: Every link that leaves a Model page for the library (23 on the front page, including each figure's trace control and "Back to the report") opens "No such issuer", because the model fixture's only issuer is not in the library fixture.
expected: A trace control opens that figure's evidence and "Back to the report" opens the report (control-matrix.csv CT-047; CT-041: Overview, Changes, Modules, Forecast and Evidence are populated for the run). Extends, and does not repeat, the stage 0 carry (output/0-baseline/report.md, Carried to stage 4: run-activity pages link to #/library/transdigm/..., an issuer the fixture library lacks).
actual: #/model/transdigm/2025-06-30/front holds 23 links into #/library/transdigm/2025-06-30/overview and .../evidence. Clicking "Show the sources for the bottom line" draws "Evidence / No such issuer / The library holds no issuer at this address." "Back to the report" draws "Overview / No such issuer". The five Model tabs are therefore the only working navigation on the page, and the run tabs of the Forecast page (#/model/transdigm/2025-06-30/forecast) point at the same missing library run. Same root cause as the stage 0 item; this finding records the Model group, which that line does not name.
suggested_change: Make the library and model fixtures describe one issuer and run (add transdigm to the library fixture, or give the model slice a library issuer), and add a fixture-agreement check for model-to-library links.

screen: fixture build: Library home > "Start a run"; Halden Aerostructures report > "New run" (full)
title: The blue "Start a run" and "New run" buttons of the static app open another issuer's saved running run instead of a way to start one; from Halden's report the reader is shown TransDigm Group "Running".
expected: A button named Start a run or New run starts one for the issuer in view, or says it cannot (control-matrix.csv CT-006 to CT-033 place starting a run on the Run start page; apps/issuer-library/README.md: the library "has no run controls").
actual: Both buttons are links to #/run. #/run draws "Runs / TransDigm Group - Running - Full credit review - As of Q3 FY2026", "USD 7.40 of USD 20.00", "Started today at 14:38", and a disabled "Stop run" with the note "Not available here: this page shows a saved example and is not connected to the run service." The link carries no issuer, so "New run" on Halden Aerostructures opens TransDigm Group's run. Nothing offers the Run start form (J6-009). The saved-example note is the only disclosure and sits beside Stop run, not on the button.
suggested_change: Hide the start buttons when no run service is present, or label them for what they open; never link a named issuer's "New run" to another issuer's run.

screen: fixture build: Library home cards, then the four issuer history pages Corvane Packaging, Tessaly Foods, Ardenne Cable, Lumora Health (full)
title: Four Library home cards state a run state, a verdict sentence and a module count, but the issuer page each one opens says "No report yet" and "No report for this issuer is held in this library yet".
expected: One run, one status, one count on every screen (docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md, Process 2: "two screens disagree (a name, a figure, a status, a count)"; PRODUCT.md, Positioning: what a run could not do is stated).
actual: Corvane Packaging: card "Running, 5 of 13 modules"; its page "Report history: two runs since June 2026" directly above "No report yet". Tessaly Foods: card "Finished, 6 of 6 modules" with a full verdict; page "Report history: one run / No report yet". Ardenne Cable: card "Failed, 13 of 13 modules"; page "two runs since March 2026 / No report yet". Lumora Health: card "Capped, 7 of 13 modules"; page "one run / No report yet". Only Halden Aerostructures opens a report. The history subtitle counts runs that the same page says do not exist.
suggested_change: Derive the home card and the history page from the same run record, or give the fixture runs for these issuers; draw "No report yet" only when the subtitle counts none.

title: The Forecast tab reads "No forecast for this run" on a page whose module list shows a Forecast module as Delivered with a base case.
expected: Forecast is one thing on one screen (docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md, decision 3: the Forecast section's job is the forward cash flow model; CT-041).
actual: Overview tab strip: "Forecast  No forecast for this run" (disabled). Module row on the same page: "Forecast - Base case reaches 4.1x by September 2027; downside stays at 4.8x. - Delivered", and #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/modules/forecast opens a page saying "Leverage falls to about 4.0x by the end of 2027 on the base case". A reader cannot tell whether a forecast exists. The same two screens disagree for three of the four Halden runs (the fourth is a loading skeleton, J6-016).
suggested_change: Say which forecast the tab means (the cash flow model) and why it is absent, or rename the module so a delivered Forecast module and a missing Forecast tab are not both on screen.

title: The same net leverage of 4.6x is tagged "Reported" on Overview and "adj." (company-adjusted EBITDA) in the Library list, and carries no basis on the Overview headline card.
expected: Exact values survive every boundary, with the basis of a figure stated the same way wherever it appears (PRODUCT.md, Product principle 4; AGENTS.md: preserve values, periods, units and limitations).
actual: Library List, Halden row: "4.6x adj. - Company-adjusted EBITDA, year to 30 Sep 2026". Overview "Supports the view" card: "4.6x Net leverage fell from 4.9x ..." tagged "Reported". Overview headline card: "Net leverage 4.6x - Net debt to EBITDA" with no basis while its neighbour reads "EBITDA margin 23.1% Company-adjusted basis". Overview Limitations: "Halden is company-adjusted". The Capital structure page repeats 4.6x with no basis. Which label is right cannot be told from the screens.
suggested_change: Take the basis tag from the figure's own record on every screen and show it on the headline card.

screen: fixture build: clicking outward from Library home, all pages (full)
title: Following every link from the Library home reaches 79 screens, but no link on any of them leads to the Model Forecast page, any Run start page, ten of the eleven run-activity states, two library issuers or one Halden run, so those routes exist only for a reader who types the address.
expected: docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md (J6 row: "Visits every library and model route from the home page by clicking only"); apps/issuer-library/README.md (Forecast and Run activity are pages of the library).
actual: Probe result: pagesFollowed 79; no inbound link for #/model/<issuer>/<run>/forecast, #/run/start/*, #/run/activity/<state> other than running, Brevane Marine and Corvane Fasteners (in the library data, absent from the home page), Halden's 30 Jun 2026 run. The "Runs" breadcrumb on a run page links to #/run, the same page, so the static app has no list of runs. The Forecast page is reachable only through a library run's Forecast tab, and no library run in the fixture has a working one. The Modules page without a module is also unlinked (the tab goes to the first module); that one is harmless.
suggested_change: Link each route from the page a reader would expect it on (a runs list from Run activity, every library issuer on the home page, a library run that has a forecast), or drop the routes the static app will not use.

screen: fixture build: #/run/start/start then the "Start a paid run?" dialog then #/run/start/started (full)
title: In the static app, which has no run service, the example Start step offers an enabled Submit; confirming the paid-run dialog draws "Run started ... The run carries on" although the page made no request of any kind.
expected: The only paid action is an analyst's Submit on an approved summary against a service, and a page that cannot start a run must say so (AGENTS.md, Paid execution; control-matrix.csv CT-029, CT-031, CT-032; the Documents step of the same form already says "Not available here: this page shows a saved example and is not connected to the run service").
actual: The saved-example notice appears on the Documents and More context steps only (documents true, purpose false, confirm false, context true, start false, started false). On Start the button "Submit, spend up to USD 20.00" is enabled; the dialog "Start a paid run? ... Once it starts, what it has spent cannot be taken back" has "Start run, up to USD 20.00"; clicking it draws "Run started - 13 modules will read 4 documents for a full credit review of TransDigm Group. Spending stops at USD 20.00 ... You can close this page. The run carries on, and its library appears under TransDigm Group when it finishes." The page called fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and WebSocket zero times and the CSP is connect-src 'none', so nothing started or could start. Only a typed address reaches it today (J6-009), so it is Medium; it becomes High if a delivered data file can carry run drafts.
suggested_change: Disable Submit and the dialog's confirm in the static app and carry the saved-example notice on every step, including "started".

title: Every page has the same document title, "Credit OS", so the tab, the browser's history list and a screen reader's page-change announcement cannot tell the pages apart.
expected: Each page has a descriptive title (WCAG 2.4.2; PRODUCT.md, Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA is the working assumption; Back and Forward are part of this journey).
actual: document.title is "Credit OS" on #/, #/model, a Halden Overview, an Evidence page, a Model page and a run page.
suggested_change: Set the title from the matched route (page name, issuer and as-of date).

screen: fixture build: Library home search "corvane", open a card, Back (full)
title: The Library search text and filters are lost when the reader opens an issuer and presses Back.
expected: Back returns the reader to where they were (docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md, J6 row).
actual: Search "corvane" shows 1 card; open Corvane Packaging; Back: 5 cards and an empty search box. The Sector filter is lost the same way (exploratory run). Neither is in the address.
suggested_change: Keep search and filters in the hash (or in history state) and read them back.

title: The three empty states of the shipped build say the same thing three ways, use a term the reader never met ("data file"), and offer no next step.
expected: An empty state says what is empty and what to do next (PRODUCT.md, Positioning: what a run could not do is stated, not hidden). The empty shipped data file itself is carried from stage 0 and not repeated here.
actual: Library: "This data file holds no library pages". Model: "No model has been delivered yet" (reads as if a delivery is pending). Run: "No run data in this library". None has a link or button; the five icon-only rail links are the only controls.
suggested_change: Use one sentence for an empty library, say where the data file comes from, and link to the guidance for opening a populated library.

screen: shipped and fixture: any unknown address, e.g. #/nowhere (empty)
title: "Page not found" has no link or button; every other error page offers a way back.
expected: A dead end offers a way out (docs/audit/2026-11-16-final/stages/3-journeys.md, Process 2: "meets a dead end").
actual: #/nowhere draws "Page not found / No page has this address" with 0 controls in main; the rail is the only way out. "No such issuer", "No such run" and "No draft has this address" each carry a link.
suggested_change: Add "Back to the library" to the page.

title: The Overview's trace buttons share three accessible names (5 "Show sources for this figure", 6 "... this point", 5 "... this finding"), while Model pages name each one ("Show the sources for Revenue").
expected: One trace control per figure, each identifiable (control-matrix.csv CT-047; WCAG 2.4.6 and 4.1.2).
actual: Names counted on the Overview: bottom line 1, figure 5, point 6, finding 5, triggers 1, limitation 4. A screen reader's list of buttons cannot tell the figures apart; the Model page's names show it can be done.
suggested_change: Name each trace button for its figure, point or finding.

title: Halden's 30 Jun 2026 run is a "Monitoring update" in the history list and a "Full review" in its own header, has no "Open report" link, and its page stays a loading skeleton for good.
expected: One run, one pathway on every screen (docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md, decision 4: every page carries a label saying which run it shows).
actual: History row: "Run as of 30 Jun 2026 ... Finished Monitoring update", links naming this run: none. Typed Overview address: header "As of 30 Jun 2026 / Full review / Finished", one aria-busy element still present after 2.5 s. A static file has nothing to finish loading.
suggested_change: Make the fixture agree on the pathway; draw the loading state only where something loads.

title: After the Kit page is opened, a text-measurement span holding "FY21" stays in <body> at top -20000, outside the app root, and is part of the page text on every later page.
expected: Leave no element behind after leaving a page (observation; the span is aria-hidden, so no screen reader announces it).
actual: Before Kit the body text has no "FY21"; after Kit then Library the body text ends "...holds no library pages\n\nFY21" (SPAN in BODY, aria-hidden true, outside #root).
suggested_change: Remove the measurement element when its chart unmounts, or render it inside the app root.
